decisive_items: excoriated skin with plaques and focal ulceration in the upper natal cleft
response.rationale: Pilonidal disease is more likely due to the presence of a sinus tract and excoriated skin in the natal cleft, whereas hidradenitis suppurativa is also possible but less specific without additional symptoms like purulent discharge

rejected.why: no exophytic mass and no underlying abscess cavity contradict squamous cell carcinoma
chronic pressure ulcer is less specific without additional risk factors like immobility
pyoderma gangrenosum is less likely without additional symptoms like rapid progression or pathergy test
hidebound or chronic inflammatory condition is too broad without additional specific symptoms
